videoDetails.title: Silksong: Sea of Sorrow Teaser Trailer Analysis
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Team Cherry just announced new a new Silksong update coming in 2026. Grab your snorkeler and let's dive in!

If you live near Melbourne, help the Hollow Knight wiki document cut content:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TStzFo5rNTLWg2mwKlJBs-oBhmfTUrQy6Hl2KQH0rAo/edit?tab=t.0

Check out more Silksong cut content here:
https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Cut_Content

Check out the Team Cherry blogpost here:
https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/holiday2025

Sea of Sorrow teaser trailer:
https://youtu.be/qDFEeeLy6ws

Check out my Discord server, mossbag & friends!
https://discord.gg/mossbag

Please follow me on Twitter. I equate my self worth to my follower count:
https://twitter.com/mossbag69

Too cool for Twitter? Fine, here's my Bluesky:
https://bsky.app/profile/mossbag.bsky.social

Link to script/list of songs:
https://mossbag.com/scripts/silksong-sea-of-sorrow-teaser-trailer-analysis/

Translate this video into another language using Amara:
https://amara.org/videos/TityUUH5vFME/info/silksong-sea-of-sorrow-teaser-trailer-analysis

Video Chapters:
00:00 Intro
01:13 Pharloom Bay
03:55 Hornet dons a sub
04:45 Other new locations
07:15 Massive update for Hollow Knight
